card.name: Partway through oncology terms
card.fires_on: Partway through cancer-treatment words, where the word is unfinished and a cancer term completes it, such as Neoad-ju-vant, carcin-ogenic, chemor-adio-therapy, anap-lastic and KR-AS.

modes.label: Split cancer-therapy words
modes.description: An unfinished piece of a long oncology word, such as adjuvant, carcinogenic or chemoradiotherapy.
modes.example: Neoad<<ju>>vant and Adjuvant Treatment of Res

modes.label: Cancer gene and tumor names
modes.description: Part of a gene or tumor-type name in cancer patient selection text.

card.writes: It pushes toward finishing odd word pieces and away from common cancer words like cancer, oncology and clinical.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of long cancer-drug words that are not yet complete.
